stem.en: A patient has high blood sugar and very high blood insulin. Kabir says "give more insulin". What does the reading suggest?

text.en: The receivers are deaf. More insulin is more shouting. The treatment is to help cells hear again: exercise, diet, medicines that improve the relay, and insulin only as a last resort in large doses.

feedback.en: Insulin is already high and not working. The problem is downstream of the hormone.
The pancreas is doing its job and being ignored. Removing it makes the first kind of diabetes on top of the second.

text.en: The patient has no receptors at all.

feedback.en: Rare. Usually the receptors are present and the relay weak. Partial deafness, which can be improved.

explanation.en: Read both numbers. High sugar with low insulin: the gland. High sugar with high insulin: the listener.
